annotations.title: Hotspot Analysis Function
annotations.content: This function performs Find Hot Spots analysis using ArcGIS spatial analysis tools. It identifies statistically significant clusters of high values (hot spots) and low values (cold spots) in point data.

annotations.title: Hosting Server Required
annotations.content: Spatial analysis requires a hosting server with spatial analysis capabilities. This is typically available in ArcGIS Enterprise or ArcGIS Online with sufficient credits.

annotations.title: Token Authentication
annotations.content: The analysis uses the GIS connection token for authentication. This token is automatically managed by the ArcGIS Python API when you connect to your portal.

annotations.title: Service URL Format
annotations.content: Feature layer URLs must end with '/0' to reference the first layer in the service. This ensures the analysis targets the correct layer.

annotations.title: Output Properties
annotations.content: The output properties define metadata for the resulting analysis layer, including name, description, and where it's stored in your content.

annotations.title: Analysis Parameters
annotations.content: The submit URL includes key parameters: shapeType (hexagon), outputName (result metadata), analysisLayer (input data), and authentication token.

annotations.title: Job Monitoring
annotations.content: Spatial analysis runs as an asynchronous job. The script polls the job status every 5 seconds until completion, failure, or timeout (5 minutes).

annotations.title: Job Status Handling
annotations.content: Check for 'esriJobFailed' status to catch analysis failures early. Failed jobs often include error messages in the response.

annotations.title: Success Processing
annotations.content: When analysis succeeds, the script searches for the newly created result item. There's a brief delay to allow the item to be fully created in the system.

annotations.title: Connection Setup
annotations.content: Replace with your actual portal URL and credentials. Consider using environment variables or secure credential storage for production use.

annotations.title: Feature Layer Required
annotations.content: You need a point feature layer with numeric attributes for hotspot analysis. Replace 'your_feature_layer_id' with an actual feature layer ID.

annotations.title: Analysis Workflow
annotations.content: Complete workflow: 1) Connect to GIS, 2) Get feature layer, 3) Submit analysis job, 4) Monitor progress, 5) Retrieve results. This pattern works for other spatial analysis tools too.
